name: netsurit-video
description: Make Netsurit-branded animated explainer videos in the style proven on The Enterprise Brain: flat infographic illustration in the Netsurit CI, ElevenLabs narration timed to the words, optional Eleven Music, shape-morph chapters and the Netsurit end card, rendered for WhatsApp (9:16) and 16:9 with measured review checks. Includes prerequisite checks and setup guidance. By Louis de Klerk.
